description: This file defines the Camera2BasicFragment class for an Android app, which manages camera initialization, preview, and picture taking features using the Camera2 API. It includes camera setup, preview session management, permission handling, image capture, and related utility classes.

classes.name: Camera2BasicFragment
classes.description: Main class handling camera lifecycle, preview, capturing images, and permission handling for an Android camera app.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout for the camera preview.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components and sets click listeners.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Initializes output file for saving pictures.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts background thread and opens the camera if the surface is ready.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Closes camera and stops background thread.

methods.name: setUpCameraOutputs
methods.description: Configures camera parameters, selects optimal sizes, and checks features.

methods.name: openCamera
methods.description: Checks permissions and opens the camera device.

methods.name: closeCamera
methods.description: Releases camera resources.

methods.name: startBackgroundThread
methods.description: Begins background thread for camera operations.

methods.name: stopBackgroundThread
methods.description: Stops background thread cleanly.

methods.name: createCameraPreviewSession
methods.description: Sets up camera preview session.

methods.name: configureTransform
methods.description: Applies transformation matrix to camera preview based on device orientation.

methods.name: takePicture
methods.description: Initiates picture capture sequence.

methods.name: lockFocus
methods.description: Locks focus before capturing the image.

methods.name: runPrecaptureSequence
methods.description: Runs pre-capture sequence for focus and exposure.

methods.name: captureStillPicture
methods.description: Captures a high-quality still image.

methods.name: getOrientation
methods.description: Calculates JPEG orientation based on device rotation.

methods.name: unlockFocus
methods.description: Resets focus lock and resumes preview.

methods.name: showToast
methods.description: Displays a message to the user.

classes.name: ImageSaver
classes.description: Runnable to save captured Image to file.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Reads image bytes and writes to storage.

classes.name: CompareSizesByArea
classes.description: Comparator for comparing Size objects by area.
